annotations.text:
The change that does the work: the You said / We did exchange moves out of section five and into the hero. It is the thing that makes a manager think "I want to be able to post that" — and it lands in about two seconds.

The live page also never mentions patients. The band below the fold now names the chain: safe to say → acted on → visible → caught earlier.

Two alternate hero directions, on different axes — not five shades of the same idea.

Warm: parchment ground, softer register, aimed at the manager.
Executive: leads with the annual-survey failure, aimed at the CNO with a turnover problem.
